name: impella device
description: Percutaneous microaxial ventricular assist device (Impella) seen on imaging; includes identification, positioning, integrity, migration, and associated complications such as effusion or thrombus.

attributes.name: impella presence
attributes.description: Whether an impella device is seen on the study.

values.name: present
values.description: Impella device visualized.

values.name: absent
values.description: No impella device visualized.

attributes.name: device status
attributes.description: Clinical/radiologic status of the device compared with prior studies or at the time of examination.

values.name: new
values.description: Device newly placed since prior imaging or first documented on this study.

values.name: unchanged
values.description: No interval change compared with prior imaging.

values.name: complication
values.description: Imaging findings suggest device-related complication (e.g., malposition, migration, compromised integrity).

values.name: removed
values.description: Device has been removed prior to or during the study.

attributes.name: device location
attributes.description: Anatomic chamber or location of the impella tip/inflow portion.

values.name: left ventricle
values.description: Inflow portion within the left ventricular cavity.

values.name: right ventricle
values.description: Inflow portion within the right ventricular cavity.

values.name: other
values.description: Location other than left or right ventricle (specify in free text).

values.name: uncertain
values.description: Location not clearly determinable on the study.

attributes.name: inflow cannula position
attributes.description: Position adequacy of the inflow/cannula portion within the ventricle.

values.name: adequate
values.description: Inflow cannula positioned appropriately within the ventricle.

values.name: inadequate
values.description: Inflow cannula malpositioned or not optimally within the ventricle.

values.name: uncertain
values.description: Position cannot be reliably assessed.

attributes.name: outflow cannula position
attributes.description: Anatomic location of the outflow portion of the device.

values.name: aorta
values.description: Outflow positioned within the aorta (expected for typical left-sided impella).

values.name: pulmonary artery
values.description: Outflow positioned within the pulmonary artery (atypical/right-sided configuration).

values.name: other
values.description: Outflow in another location or not clearly visualized.

attributes.name: device integrity
attributes.description: Visual assessment of the physical integrity of the device.

values.name: intact
values.description: No visible disruption or break in device components.

values.name: compromised
values.description: Evidence suggesting device fracture, discontinuity, or other integrity concerns.

values.name: uncertain
values.description: Integrity cannot be reliably assessed on the study.

attributes.name: device migration
attributes.description: Radiographic evidence that the device has migrated from its expected position.

values.name: present
values.description: Device migration identified.

values.name: absent
values.description: No migration identified.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Migration cannot be assessed.

attributes.name: pericardial effusion
attributes.description: Presence of fluid in the pericardial space which can be related to device placement/complication.

values.name: present
values.description: Pericardial effusion visualized.

values.name: absent
values.description: No pericardial effusion visualized.

values.name: size small
values.description: Small effusion.

values.name: size moderate
values.description: Moderate effusion.

values.name: size large
values.description: Large effusion.

attributes.name: thrombus formation
attributes.description: Thrombus associated with the device or within cardiac chambers.

values.name: present
values.description: Thrombus identified.

values.name: absent
values.description: No thrombus identified.

values.name: attached to device
values.description: Thrombus seen adherent to the device components.

values.name: uncertain
values.description: Thrombus cannot be reliably assessed.
